% KOMA-Script's footnotes in the default font, without hyperref:
% scrartcl's default \deffootnote, whose text starts left of its mark,
% with an ordinary mark and a wide one. Each footnote keeps the words and
% spaces of the PDF.
\documentclass{scrartcl}
\begin{document}
Text one.\footnote{I thank a reader.}
Text two.\footnote[20]{I owe this here.}
Text three.\footnote[1000]{I am a fan of it.}
\end{document}
